notes: This is an honest abstention with no fabricated claims (a real improvement over the 09-05 version's false 'I have documentation indexed' opener). Declining rather than guessing at software compatibility for an obsolete controller is defensible. But the recovery is generic and not tailored to an obsolete/discontinued product: it asks the technician to upload a manual or photograph the nameplate, when the actual useful next step here is contacting Festo Legacy Product Support, and it misses the chance to flag -- even with a 'general knowledge, unverified' hedge -- that WinPISA is associated with the SPC200 line, not the SPC-100, which is the central misconception in the question. Total falls well short of the pass bar; not a hallucination this time, but not a genuinely useful decline either.
